description: This is a PHP test class for the EmailQueueDao, which tests email queue operations such as retrieving, saving, removing emails, and getting all pending email IDs.

classes.name: EmailQueueDaoTest
classes.description: Test class for EmailQueueDao, containing unit tests for email queue functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test, setting up the EmailQueueDao instance and test data fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmail
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an email from the queue by ID and verifies the subject and body.

methods.name: testSaveEmail
methods.description: Tests saving a new email to the queue, verifying that the email object retains expected properties after saving.

methods.name: testRemoveFromQueue
methods.description: Tests removing emails from the queue by IDs and checks the count of removed entries.

methods.name: testGetAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Tests retrieving all IDs of pending emails in the queue and verifies the count and specific IDs.
